findings: The pinned pair materially differs in topic under a shared captured URL. The May 8 paired old capture is a US funding-method explainer. The November capture is the broad Link wallet overview, and an independently archived May 7 same-URL Link overview in raw/stripe-link-2025.md matches its substantive text and Invoicing route, with capture metadata and heading whitespace changes only. No product rollout follows from the pairing.

November overview describes the reusable wallet and establishes buyer locations worldwide except India, Stripe account acceptance worldwide except India, local currency settlement with Thailand/Brazil Payment Element exclusion, card presentment currencies, standard payout and recurring, manual capture, Connect, refunds and disputes at product level.

Merchant enables Link in Wallets and integrates the route; Stripe automatically displays it when the transaction is eligible. Recommended standalone Link works with dynamic payment methods and usually needs no extra configuration, yielding PaymentMethod type link and no wallet hash. The card-specific route suits card-only acceptance or card detail access and yields type card with card.wallet.type link. Both can support different underlying eligible funding types and do not by themselves identify the funding instrument.

Stripe confirms immediately and successful funds settle into Stripe balance on the card timeline independently of underlying funding type. Full and partial refunds submitted via Stripe Dashboard/API typically complete within 5–10 business days depending on bank. Stripe accepts dispute responses through Dashboard/API, with saved card versus bank-account timelines/processes potentially different.

The November US funding guide remains a separate authority for auto-enabled funding groups, eligibility, original signup/OTP details, Dashboard presentation and Charge group paths. Its 79–81 language scopes full Link disablement to groups 1–3. Keep May’s individual BNPL settings and enabling-outside-Link rule dated from the paired old capture; November broad overview is silent.
